description: StatHead TRADE values: what managers actually pay, fitted to millions of completed two-team trades in public Sleeper dynasty and keeper leagues (every trade read as an even swap; values additive: two 50s trade for one 100; 100 = a mid 1st in the next rookie draft, the same week). StatHead model output only — no trade, league or manager is ever shown, and no third-party ranking is involved; this is a separate StatHead number from get_dynasty_values (a list price blended from dynasty markets): the gap between the two is where the trade market disagrees with the list. Every value is AS OF its week (fitted from trades up to then only), so the history can be backtested, and each week's trades priced with the previous week's values are off by a median 0.20 in log ratio (held-out leagues 0.19 vs 0.41 for counting assets). Published values are for no TE premium and 4-point passing TDs; scoring= re-prices TEs and QBs with the fitted premium factors (a TE in a 0.75+/catch premium league trades at ~1.21x). view=players (default): value, rank, 90% range (ciLow/ciHigh), 1/4/12-week change, trend, volatility, liquidity (trades4w/tradesAll), 52-week high and distance from it; include_forecast adds StatHead's 1/3/6/12-month value forecasts (fc1m..fc1y, LightGBM on as-of log returns, walk-forward skill 3-6% over no-change, direction hit 65-76%, 80% band coverage ~78-81%). view=picks: rookie-pick classes (round x seasons ahead x early/mid/late tier from the original owner's standing) from pick-for-pick trades, global and the last 120 days, with 90% ranges and the realized return of each slot tier. view=history (needs player_name): the weekly as-of value series, players in 100+ trades. Defensive players (IDP) are valued from IDP leagues only and left out unless position=IDP. Superflex is the default format (most of the trades); 1qb is fitted separately. Use for trade evaluation at market price, spotting movers and liquidity, and comparing against the StatHead blend. See also: get_metadata for season coverage, valid enums, and analytic caveats.

fields.description: Comma-separated columns to return (any field on the rows)

include_forecast.description: Add the 1/3/6/12-month value forecasts (fc1m, fc3m, fc6m, fc1y; fc1yLo / fc1yHi via fields)

min_trades.description: Only players in at least this many trades over 4 weeks (liquidity floor; default 0)

player_name.description: Filter by player name (required for view=history)

position.description: QB / RB / WR / TE, or IDP for defensive players (valued from IDP leagues only)

scoring.description: Re-price TEs / QBs for a league's scoring: standard (default: no TE premium, 4-pt pass TD), tep0.5 (TE premium under 0.75 a catch), tep1.0 (0.75+ a catch), passTd6 (6-pt passing TDs)

view.description: players (default), picks, or history (one player's weekly as-of values)

name: get_trade_values
